institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-savings-dreams-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention dreams or future aspirations predict slower funding.
female-savings-dreams-slower.body: Pitches from women that focus on dreams, aspirations, or the goal of saving money tend to fund more slowly.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-age-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age fund more slowly.
female-age-slower.body: Pitches from women that include the borrower's age tend to fund more slowly than those that omit it.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-gratitude-faster.body: Pitches from women that include specific thank you messages to the lender community tend to fund faster.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years the business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the duration of business operation tend to accelerate funding speed for both men and women.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

female-educational-goals-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific educational goals for children fund faster.
female-educational-goals-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference school fees or educational objectives for their children tend to accelerate funding.

hardship-gender-interaction.body: Details regarding personal hardships may accelerate funding for women but slow it for men.

female-ag-success-slower.body: Mentioning previous business success in agricultural pitches may predict slower funding for women.

female-professional-values-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention professional values, such as customer service, may fund faster.

male-length-slower.body: Pitches from male borrowers that are longer in length may predict slower funding.

male-equipment-specificity-slower.body: Mentioning specific equipment models or electronics may predict slower funding for male borrowers.

female-environmental-benefits-faster.body: Mentioning environmental benefits in sanitation pitches may accelerate funding for women.

female-loan-repayment-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention previous loan repayment or microfinance eligibility may fund more slowly.

female-local-currency-faster.body: Specifying the loan amount in local currency may accelerate funding for female borrowers.

female-environmental-challenges-slower.body: Detailed descriptions of the local environment or external challenges may predict slower funding for women.

female-child-count-slower.title: Specifying the number of children may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
female-child-count-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning children or education predicts faster funding.

female-length-faster.title: Pitches from female borrowers that are shorter in length may fund faster.
female-length-faster.retrospective: Dropped from puzzles to make room for new observations.

male-living-conditions-faster.title: Pitches from men that describe specific living conditions may fund faster.
male-living-conditions-faster.retrospective: Dropped from puzzles to make room for new observation on loan history/training.

female-loan-training-faster.title: Mentioning previous loan history or formal training may accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-loan-training-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning past loans to expand/sustain business predicts slower funding.

female-financial-specificity-slower.title: Pitches from female borrowers that specify exact loan amounts in local currency tend to fund more slowly.
female-financial-specificity-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted community benefit claim.

female-pig-fattening-slower.title: Pitches from women mentioning pig fattening businesses may fund more slowly.
female-pig-fattening-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for new puzzles regarding loan repayment and boilerplate text.

female-boilerplate-inventory-slower.title: Using boilerplate or identical phrasing for store inventory descriptions may predict slower funding for women.
female-boilerplate-inventory-slower.retrospective: Dropped from puzzles to make room for PHP specificity observation.

female-php-specificity-slower.title: Mentioning specific loan amounts in Philippine Pesos (PHP) may predict slower funding for women.
female-php-specificity-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that local currency amounts predict faster funding.

female-child-count-specificity-slower.title: Specifying the exact number of children may predict slower funding for female borrowers, distinct from general mentions of children.
female-child-count-specificity-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that child count specificity paired with gratitude predicts faster funding.

female-detailed-background-slower.title: Pitches from women that include extensive details about their origins or personal history tend to decelerate funding.
female-detailed-background-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific personal background details (refugee/marital status) correlate with faster funding.
